sections.A: Trigger finger mein tendon ya A1 pulley mota ho jata hai aur ungli morte-kholte waqt atakti hai. Is chapter mein mallet, boutonniere, jersey finger aur kate hue tendons bhi hain.
sections.B: Trigger finger: click, atakna ya lock hona, subah zyada, ungli ki base par dard wala daana. Mallet: ungli ka sira latakta hai aur seedha nahi hota.
sections.D: A1 pulley dabana aur har ungli ke tendon ko alag alag test karna.
sections.G: Kheenchne ki chot ke baad ungli ka sira na murna (jersey finger), ya kat lagne ke baad movement ya sensation khatam: foran hand surgeon.
sections.H: Taaza chot mein active movement na ho to tendon pehchanein; jersey finger aur kate tendon surgeon ke paas. Baaqi ka ilaaj splint aur exercise.
sections.I: Trigger finger: MCP ko halka seedha rakhne wala splint (aksar raat ko) aur zor ki pakar kam. Mallet: sira lagataar seedha rakhne wala splint.
sections.M: Active range, atakne ki frequency, extension lag, grip aur kaam dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Mallet splint kabhi sira latka kar na utarein, warna healing kharab ho jati hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
